mission: Ben arrives at Tarn Velos Coastal Detention Works, a storm-lashed industrial coastal prison. He moves through processing under his low-profile cover as a GA Justice records auditor and is shown to the visitor room. Talon is brought in. Talon enters as quick, funny, restless, and difficult. He recognizes the duplicated manifest fragment as a cloned shipment identity, not a clerical mistake, and clocks Ben as Skywalker, Jedi, and former GAG. His jokes test Ben, hide fear, and keep the visitor room from becoming solemn. Include a humanizing prison-habit beat: Talon sits where he can see the door, counts guards mid-joke, keeps his hands visible, pockets food automatically, or otherwise reveals how prison trained his body before he can hide it.
why_now: Chapter 6 occupies the setup phase and carries the next locked outline turn.
conflict: Talon must be enjoyable immediately, but the reader should sense pressure under the performance. The prison environment — storm sound through the walls, cold metal, sea air through the ventilation — should ground the meeting in a real place.
turning_point: The prison alarm changes pitch; Talon notices it is wrong.
closing_hook: The prison alarm changes pitch; Talon notices it is wrong.
setting: Tarn Velos Coastal Detention Works, a storm-lashed industrial coastal prison on a remote world. Ben moves through processing under his low-profile cover as a GA Justice records auditor. The visitor room: gray durasteel walls, sea-air through the ventilation, the constant percussive rhythm of distant storm surge on the sea wall, a single transparisteel panel between Ben and Talon.
